mapper.insert:
select seq_orders.nextval from dual
insert into orders values(#{order_id},#{store_id},#{order_date},#{total_supply_amount},#{commission_amount})
mapper.select: select o.order_id,o.order_date,c.category_name,p.product_name,cnt.cnt -1 as extra_count from orders o join ( select order_id, min(order_item_id) as rep_order_item_id, count(*) as cnt from order_item group by order_id ) cnt on o.order_id = cnt.order_id join order_item oi on oi.order_item_id = cnt.rep_order_item_id join product p on p.product_id = oi.product_id join category c on c.category_id = p.category_id where o.store_id = #{value} order by o.order_date desc

select oi.order_item_id, p.product_name, c.category_name, oi.order_qty, p.hq_supply_price, (oi.order_qty * p.hq_supply_price) as total_price from order_item oi join product p on p.product_id = oi.product_id join category c on c.category_id = p.category_id where oi.order_id = #{order_id}
select order_id, order_date from orders where order_id=#{order_id}
